runtime.execution: Historical GitHub webhook/CLI Python threaded pipeline; synchronous model SDK streaming; independent process pool reviews
runtime.service_boundary: Owns clone/staged file state and worker threads; consumes GitHub/provider/Mongo services. Current JetBrains product pointed to by README is not audited by this historical code.

summary: Issue/comment-to-plan-to-edit-to-commit/PR automation with focused XML edit tools, baseline validation and seeded review voting.

inspection.scope: CLI/API event worker scheduling, planning-to-edit-to-PR pipeline, edit parser/dispatch/results/continuation, provider calls, context reset, Mongo logging and validation/matching oracle.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Current JetBrains product implementation unavailable here; full retrieval/index pipeline, all review/rerank executors and extension/IDE frontend not exhaustively studied. No runtime tests executed.

actions.authority: Model in cloned repository file staging.

actions.authority: Authorized GitHub event; no agent-to-agent messaging.

filesystem.detail: Model make_change/create_file stage code; host clone/rename/commit/PR writes.

processes.detail: Host linter subprocesses, API worker threads, review multiprocessing pool; no general model Bash action in traced edit set.

code_actions.detail: Model text edits with parse/lint feedback; no generic model code execution in traced dispatch.

persistent_kernel.detail: No persistent code kernel/native process namespace in API/edit/provider/linter paths.

standing_database.detail: ChatLogger consumes Mongo for optional normalized chats/tickets, but model has no table/database actions.

workflow_programming.detail: Python callable streamable plan/edit/validate/publish stages; fixed host pipeline, not model-programmable general orchestration.

multi_model.detail: Edit retry escalation uses configured faster/slower model; no simultaneous peer roles demonstrated by provider selection.

live_collaboration.detail: Seeded independent review samples voted after join and GitHub human comments; no running model peer bus.

concurrent_work.detail: Independent issue/review threads, logging threads and five review processes; comment sequencing per PR queue.

steering_interrupt.detail: New issue/review injects SystemExit to old Python thread; no join/provider/process-quiescence handshake. Comments queued.

turn_redefinition.detail: Replaceable Python generator stages/prompts can be programmed by host; model native edit tools do not install a new live turn.

compaction.detail: After changed completed task both model and detailed logger histories replaced with system/current code state; no managed choice/retention transaction.

context_repair.detail: Current files/plan re-rendered, prior detail lost from both histories and optional expiring logs; no model original-message repair API traced.

original_audit.detail: Optional Mongo normalized chat logging is detached, expiring and may omit earlier detail after reset; synthetic assistant calls and stop truncation mean not original provider audit.

audit_query.detail: Mongo records and external progress IDs aid operator study; no native model audit query.

hot_change.detail: No after-turn/workflow activation or hot prompt/program reload transaction in inspected captured pipeline.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Webhook/CLI reruns new pipeline; no paused owned work/outpost/recompile/reinhabitation in inspected paths.

remote_services.detail: Consumes GitHub repository APIs, OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock providers and optional Mongo.

self_improvement.detail: Automatic code-edit/lint repair and multi-sample review are search primitives for target repo, not governed harness self-improvement.

complaints.detail: Tracking IDs/errors and PostHog host events exist; no model complaint with captured agent state/bead custody.

authority.detail: Configured GitHub delegation automatically commits/creates regular PR; edit tool directory/existence checks, no individual command gate in this path.

evaluation.detail: Inspected matching test has concrete deterministic oracles; linter syntax checks are not behavioral correctness and skipped tasks still complete.

time_order.detail: Tracking IDs/queue sequence and Mongo index structure events; detached shared-index logging and destructive context prevent complete causal ordering.

evidence.claim: Pinned repo directs current product to JetBrains; inspectable source is earlier GitHub automation, not proof of new product mechanics.

XML parser groups matches per known tool name; no native provider tool schema in edit path.

create_file records text into file dict after directory/existence checks.
make_change operates latest code from clone/file dict; original/new code and replace_all.
Replacement and parser/linter comparison, baseline-relative failing-parse detection.

Anthropic/Bedrock stream normalizes messages and accumulates text; no request cancellation contract here.

Five seeded reviewer processes or sequential samples; joins process pool before collecting/voting; not live peer bus.

Whitespace, exact, ambiguous first-match and no-match assertions for matching primitive.

tests.oracle: Exact expected scores/first-occurrence/no-match and whitespace positives/negative; primitive only, not edit completion/process quiescence.
